market_contract.who: Teams that already know the AI, SaaS or workflow decision and need a reviewable business case.
market_contract.problem: A renewal, budget request or automation idea is approaching, but value cannot be explained with visible assumptions.
market_contract.free: Use the Waste Calculator, Spend Checklist or Workflow Diagnostic first when the problem is still unclear.
market_contract.deliverable: Self-service baseline, value assumptions, full-cost review and an explicit go / test / redesign / stop threshold.
market_contract.scope: Self-service only; no custom consulting, legal advice, implementation or guaranteed ROI.
market_contract.timing: Use before budget approval, renewal or implementation spend.
market_contract.next: Buy only when the problem is already defined; otherwise stay on the free layer.
market_contract.after: Use the purchase delivery/download link, then return to Buyer Workspace and re-measure later.

market_contract.who: Small teams with material AI or SaaS spend and a concrete renewal, overlap, sizing or consolidation decision.
market_contract.problem: A renewal or stack change is near and the cost/value picture is not clear enough for a defensible decision.
market_contract.free: Use the Calculator and Checklist first; the $39 kit is the cheaper layer when internal ownership is enough.
market_contract.deliverable: Stack Map, Leak Map, Ranked Actions, ROI Scenarios, Checkpoints and a 30-Day Plan.
market_contract.scope: Selected stack, approximate spend, usage, renewal timing and workflow value; no implementation, vendor representation, legal advice, contract negotiation or guaranteed savings.
market_contract.timing: Target delivery: 3 business days after complete intake.
market_contract.next: Buy only when the value of a better decision can reasonably justify the fee; otherwise use $39 or free.
market_contract.after: Use the written plan internally; recovery or monitoring is optional only if recurring drift remains.

market_contract.who: Existing audit clients or teams with recurring renewal, overlap or plan-sizing drift.
market_contract.problem: The same spend-control problem keeps returning after a one-time decision.
market_contract.free: Re-measure with the Waste Calculator; a one-time audit should remain enough when drift is not recurring.
market_contract.deliverable: Recovery support tied to mutually verified savings, or monthly renewal, overlap, plan-sizing review and prioritized actions.
market_contract.scope: Post-audit optional recurring decision support; not license-management software; no fee on hypothetical recovery.
market_contract.timing: Recurring only while oversight remains useful; recovery is available after a completed Stratum spend audit.
market_contract.next: Subscribe only if recurring drift costs more than recurring oversight.
market_contract.after: Stop recurring support when control is stable and return to free measurement.

market_contract.who: Teams with one clearly named recurring workflow where cost, delay or coordination burden is material.
market_contract.problem: You need to decide whether and how to automate one workflow before funding implementation.
market_contract.free: The Workflow Diagnostic can be the correct end state; the Sample Audit shows the deliverable structure.
market_contract.deliverable: Workflow Map, Leak Analysis, 5–10 Ranked Opportunities, ROI Scenarios, Human Checkpoints and a 30-Day Action Plan.
market_contract.scope: One recurring workflow; asynchronous written decision support; no guaranteed savings or ROI.
market_contract.timing: Target: 3 business days after complete intake.
market_contract.next: Buy only when the workflow is recurring, material and clearly defined.
market_contract.after: Act on one bounded change, then re-run the Workflow Diagnostic.

market_contract.who: Individual operators, commercial implementers and agencies running AI work across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or other runtimes.
market_contract.problem: You are adding agents, switching runtimes or increasing autonomy and need policies, human gates, cost controls and state handoff to stay portable.
market_contract.free: Use Agent Economics and Control Auditor first if economics or authority boundaries are still unclear.
market_contract.deliverable: Editable v1.0 Markdown + YAML operating files: master policy, adapters, conflict checks, Human Gate rules, cost guardrails and migration/state handoff.
market_contract.scope: License varies by use; v1.0 access only. No implied major upgrades, custom implementation, consulting or 1:1 support.
market_contract.timing: Use before scaling autonomy or migrating runtimes; purchase is verified before private workspace access.
market_contract.next: Choose the smallest license matching actual use.
market_contract.after: Verify purchase, open the buyer workspace, implement, then re-run economics and control checks.
